name: Matild Palace,a Luxury Collection Hotel, Budapest
positioning: Matild Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel: one of twin Baroque palaces from 1902 beside the Elisabeth Bridge in central Budapest, restored and reopened as a hotel in 2021
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palace base in central Budapest with Danube views
Couples looking for a spa with thermal therapies and Hammam rituals

facts.text: The palace was originally conceived in 1902 by Archduchess Maria Klotild of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha as twin Baroque palaces flanking the Elisabeth Bridge.
The twin Baroque palaces were designed by the architects Giergl and Korb.
After a meticulous restoration, it reopened as a Luxury Collection hotel in 2021, blending Austro-Hungarian grandeur with contemporary refinement.
The hotel is at Váci utca 36 in central Budapest.
The interiors pair classic Art Nouveau features with a modern touch and a heritage palette with pops of teal, gold and copper.
Every guest room has the Andrea Collection bed linens by Frette.
The suites include the Crown Tower Suite and the Maria Klotild Royal Suite.
Rooms offer Danube River views, and there are family-friendly connecting rooms.
Ocean Spa is inspired by the tranquility and beauty of the sea.
Ocean Spa treatments use ESPA products.
Spago by Wolfgang Puck Budapest is the European debut of Puck's Beverly Hills restaurant.
All members of the concierge team wear the gilt keys of Les Clefs d'Or.

highlights.text: The palace was home to the Belvárosi Kávéház, a Belle Époque haven for artists and thinkers, where Gyula Krúdy found inspiration for his character Sindbad.
Ocean Spa offers traditional thermal therapies and Hammam rituals.
Bathrooms are inspired by Hungarian thermal bath culture, with mosaic tiles and marble surfaces.
Rooms have headboards with Hungarian handcrafting, Hungarian fishbone parquet floors and artwork referencing Budapest literature.
The Duchess is a secret liquor library and rooftop bar with panoramic views, reached through a hidden entrance of private elevators.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
